spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (विलति)
1 To wear, to put on, to clothe or cover.
2 To break or divide.
r. 10th cl. (वेलयति)
To throw, to cast, to direct or send.

n. (-लं)
1 A hole, a chasm, a vacuity.
2 A cave, a cavern.
m. (-लः)
1 One of INDRA'S horses.
2 A sort of reed or cane, (Calamus rotang.)
E.
विल to divide, &c., aff. क.

n. (-ल्लं)
1 A pit, a hole.
2 Asafoetida.
E.
विल a hole, लच् aff.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
1 Astonished, surprised.
2 Abashed, ashamed.
3 Markless, having no mark or aim.
4 Contra-indicated, having a character or mark contrary to what is usual or natural.
5 Having no characteristic mark or property.
E.
वि before लक्ष to see, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Other, different.
n. (-णं)
1 State or condition for which no cause can be assigned, vain and causeless state.
2 Seeing, observing.
E.
वि privative or negative, and लक्षण a mark or sign.

Shame.
2

Surprise.
3

Absence of mark or aim.
4 Absence of distinguishing property.
E.
त्व added to विलक्ष; also with तल् aff. विलक्षता.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Seen, observed.
2 Affected without a cause.
3 Undiscriminated, unmarked.
E.
वि inten. or priv., and लक्षित marked.

mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
Joined or attached to, fixed on or connected with.
n. (-ग्नं)
The waist, the middle.
E.
वि before लग to be connected with, क्त aff., form irr.

n. (-नं)
Overstepping, transgressing.
E.
वि before लघि to leap over, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be transgressed or overstepped.
E.
वि before लघि to leap over, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Transgressed, overstepped.
E.
वि before लघि to leap over, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं)
Shameless, impudent, unabashed.
E.
वि privative, लज्जा shame.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Modest.
E.
वि before लस्ज to be modest, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्)
1 Speaking, talking.
2 Prating, talking idly or wildly.
E.
वि before लप to speak, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 The dirt or sediment of any oily substance, as of clarified butter, &c.
2 Talking, chattering, talking idly or wildly.
E.
वि before लप to speak, aff. ल्युट्.

Said.
2

Chattered.
3

Lamented, spoken in grief, spoken idly.
E.
वि before लप to speak, क्त aff.

m. (-म्बः)
1 Falling or hanging down, pendulousness.
2 Slowness, tardiness, delay.
E.
वि before लबि to go, aff. अच्.

n. (-नं)
1 Delaying, retarding.
2 Hanging on or from, depending.
E.
वि before लबि to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Suspended on, hanging on or from.
E.
वि before लबि to go, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Falling, pendulous, hanging or fallen down.
2 Slow, tardy, retarded.
3 Slow, (as time in music,) adagio.
E.
विलम्ब delay, &c., इतच् aff.

mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि)
1 Delaying, retarding.
2 Pendulous, depending, hanging on or from.
m. (-म्बी)
The thirty-second year of the Indian cycle.
E.
विलम्ब slowness, delay, इनि aff.

m. (-म्भः)
Gift, donation, giving.
E.
वि reverse, लभि to get or gain, aff. अच्.

m. (-यः)
1 Destruction of the world.
2 Destruction in general.
3 Liquefaction.
E.
वि before ली to liquefy, aff. अच्.

Destroying.
2

Corroding, eating away.
3

Liquefying.
4

Removing, taking away.
5 Attenuating, (as the fluids of the body.)
6 An attenuant.
7 An escharotic.
E.
वि before ली to melt, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-ला)
A sort of Sida, (S. cordifolia, &c.)
E.
वि before लल to shake, aff. अच् and टाप्.

m. (-लः)
1 An instrument, a machine.
2 A cat.
E.
वि before लल to desire, &c., aff. घञ्, or विडाल as above, and ड changed to its congener ल.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Living in a hole, burrowing.
m. (-सी)
A snake.
E.
विल a hole, and वासिन् who inhabits.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Living or burrowing in holes.
m. (-यः)
A snake.
E.
विल a hole, शी to sleep, aff. श.

mfn. (-सन्-सती-सत्)
1 Shining, beautiful, splendid.
2 Sportive, wanton.
E.
वि before लस to shine, &c., aff. शतृ.

n. (-नं)
Sporting, dallying.
E.
वि before लस to shine, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sportive, wanton.
n. (-तं)
Wanton pastime or gestures.
E.
वि before लस to shine, क्त aff.

m. (-पः)
Lamentation, the language of grief and distress.
E.
वि before लप to speak, aff. घञ्.

m. (-सः)
1 One kind of feminine action, considered as proceeding from and indicative of amorous sentiments; change of place, posture, gait or look, on the approach of the lover, as hiding at his approach, assuming a look of displeasure, &c.
2 Sport, pastime, play, especially amorous pastime, dalliance, wantonness.
3 Grace, elegance.
E.
वि before लस to desire, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
A pleasure ground.
E.
विलास sport, and कानन a wood, a grove.

n. (-रं)
A pleasure house, a summer house, &c.
E.
विलास sport, and मन्दिर a building.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Sportive, dallying, wanton.
E.
विलास, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Greedy, covetous.

f. (-का)
A drama in one act on any light subject or adventure.
E.
वि, लस to shine, ण्वुल् aff. fem. form.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Wanton, sportive, dallying.
m. (-सी)
1 VIṢṆ

The moon.
3

Fire.
4

A sensualist, an enjoyer.
5 A snake.
6 Ś

IVA.
7
KṚṢṆ

KĀMA or CUPID.
f. (-सिनी)
1 A woman.
2 A whore, a harlot.
E.
विलास pastime, &c., aff. इनि or वि, लस to shine, घिनुण् aff.; also read विलाषिन्.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Anointed, plastered, smeared.
E.
वि before लिप to smear, क्त aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Liquid, liquified, semifluid, as melted oil or butter, &c.
2 Disappeared, perished, removed from sight, either temporarily or permanently.
3 Imagined, formed or infused, as in the mind.
4 Contiguous to, in contact with, united or blended with.
E.
वि before ली to melt, &c., aff. क्त.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Seized, taken.
2 Cut off.
3 Lost.
E.
वि before लुप to cut off, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bewildered, disturbed, agitated.
2 Shaken, (by the wind.)
E.
वि before लुभ to beguile, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Tremulous, shaking, waving.
E.
वि before लुल to agitate, क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Digging, delving, rooting up.
2 Dividing, splitting.
3 Making marks or furrows.
E.
वि before लिख to write, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-पः)
1 Ointment, unguent, especially fragrant unguent of Sandal, Agallochum, &c..
2 Mortar, plaster.
3 Anointing, plastering.
(-पी)
Rice-gruel.
E.
वि before लिप to anoint or smear, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Perfume for the person, unguent or oil of Sandal, saffron, camphor, bdellium, &c.
2 Smearing the body with fragrant oils, &c.
2 Plastering.
f. (-नी)
1 A woman adorned with perfumes, &c.
2 Rice-gruel.
E.
वि before लिप to smear, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
To be spread or plastered.
m. (-प्यः)
Ricegruel.
E.
वि before लिप to smear, aff. ण्यत्

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Living or burrowing in holes.
m. (-सी)
A snake.
E.
विल 7th case, वासिन् who dwells.

m. (-यः)
1 A snake.
2 A rat.
3 A hare.
4 Any animal living or burrowing in holes.
E.
विल a hole, in the seventh case, and शय who sleeps or dwells.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Solitary, lonely.
E.
वि priv., लोक a person.

nf. (-नं-ना)
Sight, seeing, looking.
E.
वि before लोकृ to see, युच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Agreeable, beautiful, fit to be seen or looked at.
E.
वि before लोक to see, अनीयर् aff.

f. (-ता)
Loveliness, beauty.
E.
तल् added to the last.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Seeing, looking at.
E.
वि before लोक to see, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Seen, beheld.
E.
वि before लोकृ to see, aff. क्त.

n. (-नं)
The eye.
E.
वि before लोच to see, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-तः)
A glance, a look.
E.
विलोचन, and पात alighting.

n. (-म्बु)
Tears.
E.
विलोचन, and अम्बु water.

m. (-कः)
A sort of fish, (Clupea cultrata.)
E.
वि before लुट to roll on the ground, aff. खुल्.

n. (-नं)
1 Agitating, shaking, churning.
2 Rolling or tossing.
E.
वि, लुड to agitate, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Agitated, churned, shaken.
2 Rolling or tumbling on the ground.
E.
वि before लोड to be tremulous, aff. क्त.

Destruction.
2

Deluding.
E.
वि before लुप to cut, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

m. (-भः)
Attraction, delusion, seduction.
E.
वि before लुभ to delude, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Allurement, attraction, temptation, seduction.
2 Beguiling, perplexing.
3 Praise, commendation, especially by contrast with inferiority.
E.
वि before लुभ to delude, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Allured, beguiled.
2

Deceived.
3

Praised.
E.
वि before लुभ to delude, causal v., क्त aff.

ind.
Having beguiled, fascinated, &c.
E.
वि before लुभ to delude, causal v., ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being fascinated, overcome, beguiled, &c.
E.
वि before लुभ to beguile, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
Reverse, opposite, contrary, backward, against the hair or grain.
m. (-मः)
1 Reverse, opposite course or order, &c.
2 A snake.
3 VARUṆA, regent of the waters.
4 A dog.
n. (-मं)
A water-wheel or machine for raising water.
f. (-मी)
Emblic myrobalan.
E.
वि implying difference, &c., and लोम the hair of the body; also with कन् added विलोमक.

f. (-या)
1 Doing any thing backwards or in reverse order.
2 (In arithmetic,) Rule of Inversion.
E.
विलोम, and क्रिया act.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born of a father of an inferior caste and mother of a superior.
E.
विलोम inverse order, and ज born; also विलोमजात, विलोमोत्पन्न, &c.

m. (-ह्वः)
An elephant.
E.
विलोम reversed, जिह्वा the tongue.

n. (-कं)
Rule of Three inverse.
E.
विलोम, and त्रैराशिक rule of Three.

m. (-र्णः)
A man of mixed or inferior birth.
E.
विलोम contrary to the proper order, (of marriage, &c.) and वर्ण a class.

f. (-धिः)
1 Inverted or reversed ceremony.
2 (In arithmetic,) Rule of Inversion.
E.
विलोम, and विधि rule.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Shaking, trembling, tremulous.
2 Fickle, unsteady.
3 Rolling, (as the eyes.)
4 Tossing, waving.
E.
वि before लुल to agitate, aff. घञ्.

Tremulousness.
2

Unsteadiness.
3

Rolling, (of the eyes.)
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, विलोलत्वं.

n. (-नं)
Shaking, stirring, agitating.
E.
वि before लुल to agitate, causal v., aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shaken, agitated, tossed.
E.
वि before लुल to agitate, causal v., क्त aff.

m. (-काः)
Any animal living in holes, a reptile.
E.
विल, and ओकस् abode.

f. (-ला)
A sort of yam: see वाराही.

m. (-ल्वः)
A fruit tree, commonly named Bel, (Ægle marmelos.)
n. (-ल्वं)
1 The fruit of the

Bel.
2

A measure, the same as the Pala.
E.
विल to divide, Uṇādi aff. वन्.
